 manifest=dict(source='10f3e0a8',task=task,bank=bank,flags=flags,layouts=[dict(id=i,sha256=hashlib.sha256((d/f'{i}.settled.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()) for i in ids])

import sys,json,hashlib,os,subprocess,math
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.home()/'dojo-data/laptop';task,name,lock=sys.argv[1:]
source=Path.home()/'controlr-laptop/frozen-round2h'
m=json.loads((root/'round2h-panel-manifest.json').read_text());assert (source/'.deployed_commit').read_text().strip()==m['source']
assert all(hashlib.sha256((source/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for f,h in m['source_hashes'].items())
def validate(path,seed,flags):
 rr=[json.loads(l) for l in path.read_text().splitlines()]
 assert len(rr)==1
 r=rr[0]
 assert r['task']==task and r['seed']==seed and r['code']['commit']==m['source'] and r['skill_attrs']==flags
 assert r['stable'] and not r.get('missing_meshes'), 'pre-action/mesh infrastructure needs explicit adjudication'
 assert r['layout_file']==f'{seed}.settled.json'
 assert math.isfinite(float(r['score'])) and 0<=float(r['score'])<=1
 return r
for index,rec in enumerate(m['cells'][task]['selected']):
 for condition in (('A','B') if index%2==0 else ('B','A')):
  seed=rec['id'];job=f'r2h-panel-{name}-{condition}-{seed}';out=root/job;rowfile=out/f'{task}_episodes.jsonl';flags=m['profiles'][condition]
  if rowfile.exists():
   validate(rowfile,seed,flags)
   continue  # completed policy zeros are never rerun
  assert hashlib.sha256(Path(rec['layout_file']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==rec['sha256']
  log=root/'logs'/f'{job}.log';assert not log.exists(),f'inspect incomplete prior attempt; refuse overwrite {log}'
  cmd=['bash',str(root/'job-panel-h.sh'),job,'-m','dojo.skills.g3','run','--task',task,'--seeds',str(seed),'--trace','--out',str(out)]
  for k,v in flags.items():cmd+=['--skill-attr',f'{k}={v}']
  with log.open('x') as f:
   p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=dict(os.environ,LAPTOP_LOCK=lock))
   (root/f'{job}.pid').write_text(str(p.pid)+'\n');rc=p.wait()
  with (root/f'round2h-panel-progress-{name}.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'id':seed,'condition':condition,'rc':rc,'out':str(out)})+'\n')
  if rc:raise SystemExit(rc)
  assert rowfile.exists(),f'missing official outcome {job}'
  validate(rowfile,seed,flags)
(root/f'round2h-panel-done-{name}').write_text('complete\n')

import json,math,statistics as stats,sys
from pathlib import Path

x=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
m=x['manifests']['round2h-panel-manifest.json']
out={'source':m['source'],'variant':m['variant'],'salt':m['salt'],'cells':{}}
assert len(x['rows'])==40, 'complete40-row panel required; inspect missing/infra attempts explicitly'
credit=lambda r:any(abs(float(r['score'])-v)<1e-6 for v in (.2,1.))
all_wins=all_losses=0
for task,cell in m['cells'].items():
 selected={z['id'] for z in cell['selected']}
 groups={}
 for condition in ('A','B'):
  rows=[r for r in x['rows'] if r['task']==task and r['run_dir'].split('-')[-2]==condition]
  assert len(rows)==10 and {r['seed'] for r in rows}==selected
  assert all(r['code']['commit']==m['source'] and r['skill_attrs']==m['profiles'][condition]
             and r['stable'] and not r.get('missing_meshes')
             and r['layout_file']==f"{r['seed']}.settled.json"
             and math.isfinite(float(r['score'])) and 0<=float(r['score'])<=1 for r in rows)
  groups[condition]={r['seed']:r for r in rows}
  values=[100*float(r['score']) for r in rows]
  out['cells'].setdefault(task,{})[condition]=dict(n=10,mean=stats.mean(values),sample_sd=stats.stdev(values),
      headset_credits=sum(credit(r) for r in rows),full_successes=sum(bool(r['success']) for r in rows),
      steps_median=stats.median(r['steps'] for r in rows),steps_max=max(r['steps'] for r in rows))
 deltas=[100*(float(groups['B'][i]['score'])-float(groups['A'][i]['score'])) for i in sorted(selected)]
 wins=sum(d>=10-1e-6 for d in deltas);losses=sum(d<=-10+1e-6 for d in deltas)
 all_wins+=wins;all_losses+=losses
 out['cells'][task]['paired']=dict(n=10,mean_delta=stats.mean(deltas),sample_sd_delta=stats.stdev(deltas),
     wins=wins,losses=losses,ties=10-wins-losses,
     headset_win_flips=sum(credit(groups['B'][i]) and not credit(groups['A'][i]) for i in selected),
     headset_loss_flips=sum(credit(groups['A'][i]) and not credit(groups['B'][i]) for i in selected),
     full_success_win_flips=sum(bool(groups['B'][i]['success']) and not groups['A'][i]['success'] for i in selected),
     full_success_loss_flips=sum(bool(groups['A'][i]['success']) and not groups['B'][i]['success'] for i in selected))
pooled=stats.mean(c['paired']['mean_delta'] for c in out['cells'].values())
out['decision']=dict(mechanical=all(c['B']['headset_credits']>=7 for c in out['cells'].values()),
    pooled_mean_delta=pooled,score_wins=all_wins,score_losses=all_losses,
    gain=pooled>=5-1e-6 and all_wins>=2*all_losses and all_wins-all_losses>=2,
    g3_average_point_delta=sum(c['paired']['mean_delta'] for c in out['cells'].values())/120)
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
name="$1"; shift
export RD_HOME="$HOME/dojo-robodojo" DOJO_DATA="$HOME/dojo-data/laptop"
export DOJO_CATALOG="$HOME/dojo-data/skills4/catalog:$HOME/dojo-data/skills3/catalog:$HOME/dojo-perception-data/catalog"
export SIMLAB_GPU=0 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
cd "$HOME/controlr-laptop/frozen-round2h"
exec 9>>"$HOME/${LAPTOP_LOCK:?set a LAPTOP lock}"
flock -w 14400 9
source scripts/dojo/disk_guard.sh
disk_guard laptop
who > "$DOJO_DATA/logs/$name.admission"
nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,process_name,used_memory --format=csv >> "$DOJO_DATA/logs/$name.admission"
used=$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits)
printf 'time=%s used_MiB=%s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$used" >> "$DOJO_DATA/logs/$name.admission"
[[ "$used" -le 24576 ]] || exit 75
printf 'pid=%s stream=LAPTOP start=%s\n' "$$" "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" > "$HOME/${LAPTOP_LOCK:?set a LAPTOP lock}"
exec timeout -k 60 1800 systemd-run --user --scope -q -p MemoryMax=8G -p CPUQuota=600% scripts/simlab/rdpy.sh -u "$@"
